modmenu.descriptionTranslation.eternal_r: Explore the world and collect the Eternal Relics scattered across it — each one grants you a unique power.
item.eternal_relic.aota_branch.desc: While carried in your inventory: +12% max health, plus +2% for each additional branch.
item.eternal_relic.echo_ring.desc: While carried in your inventory, it wards off attacks: blows of 20 damage or less are blocked whole; heavier blows conjure 5 to 10 golden hearts to soften the hit. Each time it cracks and takes 2 minutes to mend.
item.eternal_relic.echo_ring_drained.des: Cracked, so it cannot ward off attacks for you right now. It will mend on its own before long.
item.eternal_relic.nightwatch_eye_left.d: Right-click to set it into your left eye. From then on you see clearly in the dark, at the cost of 1 heart of max health.
Right-click to set it into your right eye. From then on living creatures nearby are outlined in the dark, at the cost of 1 heart of max health.
item.eternal_relic.nightwatch_eye_left_d: Its energy is spent, so it cannot be set in. Craft it with a Bottle o' Enchanting to restore it.
item.eternal_relic.nightwatch_eye_right_: Its energy is spent, so it cannot be set in. Craft it with a Bottle o' Enchanting to restore it.
message.eternal_relic.ward_gilded: %s turns into golden hearts to share the blow for you.
item.eternal_relic.aota_branch.lore: It remembers how that tree swayed in the wind, and leaves that vigour with you.
item.eternal_relic.echo_ring.lore: Inside the breaking echo hides a resolve that refuses to die.
item.eternal_relic.nightwatch_eye_left.l: Where no one else is watching, it lights the world for you.
It does not watch what you watch. It watches everything behind you.
item.eternal_relic.aota_branch.flavor:
The Eternal Radiance Tree
shelters every living thing
beneath its light.
item.eternal_relic.echo_ring.flavor:
A small metal ring, polished
and flawless, with a sliver of
amethyst turning slowly at its
centre.
item.eternal_relic.echo_ring_drained.fla:
A small metal ring, polished
and flawless, its centre
utterly empty.
item.eternal_relic.nightwatch_eye_left.f:
This finely wrought eye sits
heavy in your hand, with
"01" engraved on its back.
This finely wrought eye sits
heavy in your hand, with
"02" engraved on its back.
item.eternal_relic.nightwatch_eye_left_d:
This finely wrought eye sits
heavy in your hand, with
"01" engraved on its back.
Lightless and dull, as if its
energy were spent.
item.eternal_relic.nightwatch_eye_right_:
This finely wrought eye sits
heavy in your hand, with
"02" engraved on its back.
Lightless and dull, as if its
energy were spent.
item.eternal_relic.soul_lantern.flavor:
A cold, hard frame of black
iron binds the pitiful soul
that flickers inside.
item.eternal_relic.relic_sample_debris.d: A test relic with no effect at all, used only to check how the Debris grade looks on the screen.
item.eternal_relic.relic_sample_debris.l: A broken shard whose name has long been forgotten.
item.eternal_relic.relic_sample_rough.de: A test relic with no effect at all, used only to check how the Rough Stone grade looks on the screen.
item.eternal_relic.relic_sample_rough.lo: Not yet shaped, but the form is already there.
item.eternal_relic.relic_sample_lumber.d: A test relic with no effect at all, used only to check how the Lumber grade looks on the screen.
item.eternal_relic.relic_sample_lumber.l: The first piece a craftsman would call good stock.
A test relic with no effect at all, used only to check how the Essence grade looks on the screen.
What remains after everything else has been burned away.
item.eternal_relic.relic_sample_treasure: A test relic with no effect at all, used only to check how the Treasure grade looks on the screen.
Rare enough that men have drawn steel over it.
A test relic with no effect at all, used only to check how the Supreme grade looks on the screen.
It has watched an age come to its end.
item.eternal_relic.relic_sample_source.d: A test relic with no effect at all, used only to check how the Source grade looks on the screen.
item.eternal_relic.relic_sample_source.l: They say all things were born from this.
item.eternal_relic.soul_lantern.desc: While carried, each creature you kill adds one wisp of soul fire (up to 13). Press G to release every wisp at once: nearby creatures are hurt and burning soul fire is left on the ground. A one minute cooldown follows, during which no wisps are gathered.
item.eternal_relic.soul_lantern.lore: What burns inside is not fire, but every death it remembers for you.
message.eternal_relic.soul_lantern_unava: The Soulfire Lantern cannot release right now: no soul fire gathered, or still cooling down.
